name: blur-reveal
blurb: Child elements reveal from blur when they enter the viewport.
description: Wraps each direct child with a viewport-triggered animation from blur+offset to sharp+in-place. Supports staggered timing.
use_when: Progressive content reveals, entrance animations, or scroll-triggered text displays.
avoid_when: Motion-sensitive users (no prefers-reduced-motion); rapidly scrolling content.
a11y: Animation wrapper; motion-based only. Does not affect semantic content.
